title: Paper Accepted in Transportation Research Part C (TRC)
abstract: SLSCM Lab warmly congratulates researchers Minh Anh Nguyen (Singapore Management University - SMU) and Thu Trang Hoa (SMU) on their accepted paper in Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies (SCIE Q1) on the Parallel Drone Scheduling Traveling Salesman Problem with Lockers.
journal: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
paper_title: The parallel drone scheduling traveling salesman problem with lockers

title: EP20 Discovery & Modeling Workshop Series
abstract: The SLSCM Lab invites students to join the EP20 Discovery & Modeling Workshop Series — an introductory program designed to explore how modern supply chains are transformed by data, optimization, and AI, turning real-world logistics challenges into mathematical models and computational decisions.
organizer: SLSCM Lab & Faculty of Data Science and AI (FDA) - NEU

title: New OPSEARCH Publication on Minimum Spanning Tree with Inner-Node Costs
abstract: Research by MSc. Nguyen Thanh Hoang (SLSCM Lab / FDA - NEU) and collaborators establishes new theoretical results on edge stability and optimal leaf connections, proposing Kruskal- and Prim-inspired branch-and-bound exact methods for the Minimum Spanning Tree with Inner-node Costs (MSTIC) problem.
paper_title: Edge-based and node-based branch-and-bound methods for minimum spanning tree with inner-node costs

title: New ITOR Publication on Parallel Machine Scheduling with Conflicting Jobs
abstract: Research focuses on scheduling conflicting jobs on identical parallel machines to minimize makespan. Proposes a novel constraint programming model and multineighborhood simulated annealing metaheuristics with proven computational efficiency.

title: Paper Accepted in INFORMS Journal on Computing (IJOC)
abstract: Investigates competitive facility location under cross-nested logit customer choice models. Establishes NP-hardness and non-concavity, then derives an exact mixed-integer exponential cone formulation solved to optimality via outer approximation.
paper_title: Competitive Facility Location under Cross-Nested Logit Customer Choice Model: Hardness and Exact Approaches

title: Young Scholar Publication in Transportation Research Part C
abstract: Introduces a novel stage-based integer formulation and metaheuristic algorithm for the Revisit Flying Sidekick TSP, enabling delivery trucks to revisit customer nodes and coordinate multi-trip drone sorties for accelerated last-mile logistics.
journal: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
paper_title: A Stage-based Formulation and Meta-heuristic Algorithm for the Revisit Flying SideKick Traveling Salesman Problem

title: Real-World Initiative: AI & OR for Hanoi Urban Smart Water Network
abstract: A collaborative smart city initiative between CADA and SLSCM Labs applying AI and Operations Research to Hanoi's municipal drainage infrastructure, integrating live IoT telemetry with machine learning for real-time flood mitigation.
collaboration: Joint Lab Initiative: CADA (P1601 A1) & SLSCM (P1613 A1) - FDA College of Technology, NEU

title: Executive Professional Workshop: Decision Intelligence & Analytics
abstract: Advanced executive training hosted by SLSCM Lab and FDA College of Technology, equipping professionals with combinatorial optimization, prescriptive analytics, and AI frameworks to solve large-scale logistical operations.
organizer: SLSCM Lab & FDA Faculty - National Economics University
